audit_sessions.summary: Independent traceability audit of the original FAZ11 delivery; found and fixed two real defects (bounded decode/embed/write pipeline, frame lifecycle).

Deep-dive verification of five previously spot-checked areas (model bundle, migration, media security, preflight no-write, manifest/telemetry semantics), completed the 10-point run-versioning fault matrix and pushdown adapter audit, added real streaming memory smoke evidence, and wrote the full operator/end-user/dataset-onboarding/Colab/acceptance documentation set. Found and fixed five more real defects (flash_attention_2 preflight gate, two migration idempotency bugs, two telemetry semantics bugs).
